Class GameController

java.lang.Object
controller.gameFlow.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
CharacterEventListener, ActionListener, EventListener
public class GameController extends Object implements ActionListener, CharacterEventListener
Controller managing the main game flow, specifically within the GameWindow.

This class handles transitions between the GameWindow and the EquipmentWindow, manages the combat simulation using turn-based calls and timers, and ensures the View elements are synchronized with the Model state.

  • Method Details

    • onStartButton

      public void onStartButton()
      Handles the action when the "Start Battle" button is pressed. Initiates the combat simulation by starting the turn cycle.

    • onEquipmentButton

      public void onEquipmentButton()
      Handles the action when the "Equipment" button is pressed. Transitions the main frame's content from the GameWindow to the EquipmentWindow.

    • showGameWindow

      public void showGameWindow()
      Displays or initializes the GameWindow as the current content of the MyFrame. This method is typically used when returning from the EquipmentWindow.

    • refreshPlayerHealthBar

      public void refreshPlayerHealthBar()
      Refreshes the main player's health bar displayed on the GameWindow. This is called by the EquipmentController when a stat change (e.g., max HP increase) occurs, ensuring the View is synchronized with the updated Model state.

    • playerAttack

      public void playerAttack()
      Manages player1's attack turn. Executes the attack logic, updates the view with damage messages and a visual flash, checks for battle end, and schedules the enemy's turn.

    • enemyAttack

      public void enemyAttack()
      Manages player2's (enemy's) attack turn. Executes the attack logic, updates the view with damage messages and a visual flash, checks for battle end, and schedules the player's turn.

    • checkBattleEnd

      public void checkBattleEnd()
      Checks the health status of both characters to determine if the battle has ended. If concluded, it sets the battleOver flag, displays Victory/Defeat messages, and triggers the experience update via handleBattleResult(boolean).

    • actionPerformed

      public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e)
      Handles actions triggered by the UI, specifically the Restart button. Resets the game state by returning to the CharacterSelection window.
      Specified by:
      actionPerformed in interface ActionListener
      Parameters:
      e - The action event triggered by the UI component (the Restart button).

    • onAttack

      public void onAttack(CharacterModel attacker, String message)
      Called by the CharacterModel when a special attack or event occurs. Displays a distinct message on the screen to inform the user of the event.
      Specified by:

      Parameters:
